objective.statement: Remove the green bordered div on HomeView.tsx and all the contents it contains.

complexity.rationale: Deleting one static presentational element in a single view; no contracts, state or approval-boundary work.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: HomeView no longer renders the green bordered div or its 'ADA plugin test' text.
The rest of HomeView (header, Clock, ModeToggle, ThemePicker, PageViewsPanel) still renders unchanged.

in.statement: src/views/home/HomeView.tsx: delete the green bordered div and its contents.

src/views/home/HomeView.component.test.tsx: replace the four tests that assert the removed div with one absence test; src/views/home/HomeView.testIds.ts: delete, as its only key belongs to the removed div.

out.statement: Any other element or view, the clock/page-views tests, e2e specs and workflow records of earlier slices.

observations.statement: The 'green bordered div' is the single div with border-green-500, aria-label 'Red bordered square' and text 'ADA plugin test' (the only bordered div in HomeView.tsx).

The four existing tests that assert the removed div's text, centring, size and border colour test intentionally removed behaviour, so they are deleted rather than kept; this is the sanctioned case for changing existing tests.
HomeView.testIds.ts holds only the removed div's id, so it is deleted along with its imports; grep found no other users in src or e2e.

provenance.source: New Feature request: Remove Green Box
Executor notice ADA_PLAN_APPROVAL=required: the owner must approve the plan before implementation.

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve this plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Awaiting owner approval of the plan.

component.rationale: Absence of the div is rendered component behaviour.

integration.rationale: No cross-module flow change; npm run test runs as regression.

e2e.rationale: No e2e spec references the removed element; static removal with no user flow.

increments.behavior: HomeView renders without the green bordered div and its text.
increments.doneWhen: t-1 passes, the four obsolete div tests and the testIds file are removed, and the full suite, lint and build stay green.

tests.description: HomeView does not render the green bordered div (no element with aria-label 'Red bordered square') nor the text 'ADA plugin test'.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: The div and the 'ADA plugin test' text are still present, so the absence assertions fail.

verification.requirement: npm run test, npm run lint and npm run build pass.
